header.title: Telegram
header.description: The bot sends alerts about marks and sessions and answers commands for your Mir Tankov account.

request.title: Linking
request.description: Get a one-time code and send it to the bot. The bot never needs your Lesta password or data.

steps.send: Tap Start or send the command with the code
steps.done: This page updates by itself once linked

request.note: The code is single-use and valid for 15 minutes. Do not forward it.

ticket.label: Link code
ticket.fallback: If the button did not work, send the bot this command

linked.description: Bot commands answer for your primary account; alerts arrive in this chat.

unlink.title: Unlink Telegram?
unlink.description: The bot will stop sending alerts and answering for your account. You can link again at any time.

commands.title: Bot commands

list.me: your stats: WN8, win rate, damage
list.marks: marks of excellence and the damage to the next one

commands.inline: inline mode: mention the bot and a nickname in any chat

miniApp.title: Mini app
miniApp.description: Stats, your last session and marks inside Telegram, no browser needed.

meta.title: Sign in with Telegram
meta.description: Sign in to Three Marks with a one-time link from the bot.

webLogin.label: Telegram sign-in

missing.title: No sign-in code
missing.description: This page opens from a link the bot sends. Send the bot {command} to get a new one.

invalid.title: Broken link
invalid.description: The code in the link is invalid; it may have been cut off when copied. Request a new one with {command}.

confirm.title: Sign in with Telegram?
confirm.description: Continue only if you asked the bot for this link yourself. Never open sign-in links other people send you.

redeeming.title: Checking the code
redeeming.description: This takes a couple of seconds.

failed.title: Link is no longer valid
failed.description: The code has expired or was already used. Request a new link with {command}.

webLogin.replaceSession: You are signed in as {name}. Continuing signs you out of that account.
